caption: 5 easy baby meals to keep in your freezer 👶✨ Perfect for busy days 🤍 Simple, nutritious, and baby-approved meals to make everyday feeding easier 🫶 ⸻ Recipes 👇 1.🐟 Salmon cookies • 220g potato • 120g salmon • 2 tsp grated cheese • 1 tbsp flour → Steam potato → blend everything → shape → bake 2.🍌 Spinach banana mini cakes • A handful of spinach • 1.5 bananas • 2 eggs → Blend → pour into freezer tray → microwave 4 mins 3.🥚 Veggie tofu egg bites • 2 eggs • 90g tofu • Veggies of choice • Tomato paste • Grated cheese → Mix → pour into tray → microwave 4 mins 4.🍙 Rice omelet balls • 150g cooked rice • 2 eggs • Veggies of choice • 1 can tuna • Tomato paste → Mix → pour into tray → microwave 4 mins 5.🐟 Salmon cream pasta • 100g uncooked pasta • 130g salmon • 80g spinach • 150ml water • 150ml milk (or plant-based) → Add everything to a pot → cook → done ⸻ Find more recipes & tools I use on Instagram! #babymealprep #babyfoodideas #babyledweaning #freezermeals #blwrecipes
